        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        Lighting.FogColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                wait(5)

                if not Lighting:FindFirstChild("DarkSky") then
                    Sky:Clone().Parent = Lighting
                end

                Lighting.Brightness = 0
                Lighting.ClockTime = 0
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                Lighting.FogColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                Lighting.FogEnd = 100
            end
        end)
    end)()
end)
v21:AddLabel("🔥 QoL:").TextSize = 17
function t1.value77()
    local v128 = t1.value2.Character:FindFirstChild("Protein Egg")

    if not v128 then
        v128 = t1.value2.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Protein Egg")
    end

    if v128 then
        t1.value5:FireServer("proteinEgg", v128)
    end
end
t1.value78 = false
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if t1.value78 then
            t1.value77()
            task.wait(1800)
        else
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end
end)

    t1.value78 = p13

    if p13 then
        t1.value77()
    end
end)

v21:AddSwitch("Spin Fortune Wheel", function(p15)
    _G.AutoSpinWheel = p15

    if p15 then
        spawn(function()
            while _G.AutoSpinWheel and wait(1) do
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").rEvents.openFortuneWheelRemote:InvokeServer("openFortuneWheel", game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").fortuneWheelChances["Fortune Wheel"])
            end
        end)
    end
end)

local v22 = v21:AddDropdown("Perk Pet Equip", function(p16)

    for v138, v139 in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.petsFolder:GetChildren()) do

        if v139:IsA("Folder") then
            for _, child in pairs(v139:GetChildren()) do
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").rEvents.equipPetEvent:FireServer("unequipPet", child)
            end
        end
    end
    task.wait(0.2)
    local t5 = {}
    for _, child in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.petsFolder.Unique:GetChildren()) do
        if p16 == child.Name then
            table.insert(t5, child)
        end
    end
    for i = 1, math.min(8, #t5) do
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").rEvents.equipPetEvent:FireServer("equipPet", t5[i])
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)
